Players Committee card image of [[Insignificant Rebellion (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If Ralltiir Operations on table, deploy on table. Forfeit values are not modified by Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Once per battle, when you draw battle destiny, may exchange a card in hand with a card of same card type in Lost Pile. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5165b3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/insignificantrebellion.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/insignificantrebellion.gif] as of commit 5165b3a “Insignificant Rebellion (V)” (1 January 2021).
